items.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I went and sat in front of Tino Brazzy, he was the person in charge of that.

ctx.x: You have to audition to be in the union?

You have to audition to be in the union, yes. I went and sat in front of Tino Brazzy, he was the person in charge of that. He asked me a bunch of questions. He says, “Now, what do you play?” I say, “Trumpet.” He says, “Let me see.” I open up my case; he looks at the trumpet, he says, “Alright, thank you. You’re in the union.” (Laughs) So, that was 1959…
He had a gold watch from the union for being in the union for more than thirty years!
